text:
Before the meal there were two bowls. One held mixed vegetables: broccoli, carrots, corn and possibly green beans, about 150 g. The other held a salad of chopped greens (spinach or romaine) with olives and some white cheese, about 80 g.

After the meal, the salad bowl is empty apart from a little dressing residue. The vegetable bowl has only corn left, about 30 g.

The vegetable mix contained about 25 g of corn, so the leftover corn is probably most of the corn. The mix was about 150 g in total, so I estimate about 120 g of vegetables eaten at roughly 0.55 kcal/g, which is about 66 kcal. The mix may also have had some butter or oil.

The salad was about 80 g at roughly 1 kcal/g with olives, cheese and dressing, so about 70 kcal.

Totals: mass eaten is about 120 + 80 = 200 g, and energy is about 66 + 70 = 136 kcal. I'll round to about 135 kcal.
